chemical_life_science_product_family.label: Chemical / life-science product family
chemical_life_science_product_family.value: Oncology pharmaceuticals, led by NERLYNX (neratinib) for HER2-positive breast cancer, with investigational alisertib for breast and lung cancers.

specialty_commodity_positioning.label: Specialty / commodity positioning
specialty_commodity_positioning.value: Specialty oncology therapeutics, including targeted kinase inhibitors for specific cancer indications.

patent_exclusivity_dependence.label: Patent / exclusivity dependence
patent_exclusivity_dependence.value: In-licensed global development and commercialization rights for neratinib and alisertib, with exclusive regional NERLYNX commercialization licenses outside the United States.

product_specific_regulatory_route.label: Product-specific regulatory route
product_specific_regulatory_route.value: NERLYNX has FDA approval and EU marketing authorization for specified breast cancer indications. Alisertib is investigational.

r_d_intensity.label: R&D intensity
r_d_intensity.value: Clinical R&D centers on advancing in-licensed oncology candidates, including alisertib trials in lung and breast cancers.

clinical_commercialization_stage_pharma.label: Clinical / commercialization stage [pharma]
clinical_commercialization_stage_pharma.value: NERLYNX is commercialized in the United States and European Union. Alisertib is in clinical trials for small cell lung cancer and metastatic breast cancer.

biologic_small_molecule_platform_pharma.label: Biologic / small-molecule platform [pharma]
biologic_small_molecule_platform_pharma.value: Small-molecule kinase inhibitors, led by oral neratinib and investigational oral alisertib.
